ac_results.ac: `src/commands/add.js` exports a function taking the raw args array and performing UC-AddTodo Steps 1–6: trim, validate non-empty, load, `addItem`, save, print confirmation to stdout, return exit code 0
ac_results.evidence: src/commands/add.js exports `run(args)` — joins+trims args, validates non-empty (else stderr + exit 1), calls store.load(), domain addItem, store.save(), writes confirmation to stdout, returns 0. Manually invoked via test/commands/add.test.js 'add a valid item' case: exit 0, stdout matches /Buy milk/, ./.todo.json contains one item with text 'Buy milk', done:false.
node --test test/commands/add.test.js → tests 4, pass 4, fail 0 (valid add, empty-args rejection, whitespace-only rejection, id-never-reused via addItem sequence).

assumptions: `add.js`'s exported function receives args already sliced past the `add` subcommand (i.e. argv.slice(3)), matching UC-AddTodo Step 1's `argv.slice(3).join(' ').trim()` — TASK-008 (dispatcher, out of this scope's Non-Go) is responsible for the argv[0..2] slicing before calling this function.

Confirmation stdout format `Added [<id>] <text>` is not specified verbatim by the contract (only 'prints confirmation line naming the item' / 'stdout confirms the addition') — chose a plain, assertable, non-colored line per ux-behavior's no-TUI/no-color no-go.

STORE_CORRUPTED handling in add.js checks `err.name === 'StoreCorruptedError'` against `../store.js`'s exported error class (TASK-003, foundation scope, frozen/read-only per this scope's contract) — verified against the landed src/store.js at implementation time.

Write-failure path (StoreWriteError) reported via a generic 'todo add: failed to save store' stderr line and exit 1, per ux-behavior's generic `error` state for `add`; not separately itemized as a distinct error code in this task's AC/BDD scenarios.
